answer: What survives to the vault is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A thread of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nebula of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
